property_summary: In any completed play() round the pot is reset to 0 exactly when the round's random outcome is 0 (payout round) and stays at TICKET_AMOUNT when it is 1; the mutant pays/resets on outcome 1 instead, leaving pot==TICKET_AMOUNT on an outcome-0 round and 0 on an outcome-1 round, which the assertion (c.pot()==0)==(random==0) detects. (The earlier failure was caused by transferring prize ETH to a non-payable test contract: bank and player are now EOAs via vm.prank.)
change_summary: Change the winning condition from 'random == 0' to 'random == 1', so the pot is reset (and prizes paid) on a different outcome.
